messages:
Ari (Design): Quick round-up from the model-catalog design review. Main takeaways: presets are not discoverable in the drawer, perf badges draw too much attention in the compare table, pinning a version disappears across sessions, and some keyboard/contrast problems remain. Ideas below, quick thumbs.

Jo (PM): Seen the support tickets. Saved views adoption low—agree we should promote presets. Suggest a compact horizontal presets toolbar above filters with a chevron to open manager.

Ben (Eng): Fine with moving it. Two engineering notes: 1) keep mobile behavior simple (collapse to an icon), 2) for persistent pins we'll need a lightweight endpoint. Will propose /api/user/pins.

Carmen (Frontend): Badge problem: current badges use saturated color + shadow which competes visually. Propose these changes: smaller font (11px), neutral 8% bg, 1px subtle border, no shadow, right-align badges in compare column. CSS sample: `.catalog-badge{ font-size:11px; background:rgba(15,23,42,0.06); border:1px solid rgba(2,6,23,0.06); padding:2px 6px; border-radius:6px; box-shadow:none; }`

Zoe (A11y): Accessibility: contrast ratios are borderline for some badge foregrounds. We need to hit at least 4.5:1 for small text if these are interactive. Also add descriptive aria-labels: e.g., `aria-label=\"Latency (98th percentile): 220 milliseconds\"`. Presets toolbar should be a true toolbar with keyboard arrows to move between items.

Ari (Design): On pin persistence: propose "Pin version (saves to your account)" tooltip. Default scope: user-level. Jo, do we want team-level later?

Jo (PM): Start with user-level for MVP. We'll add analytics events: `pin.created`, `pin.removed` including model_id + version + user_id. Team-scoped later if customers ask.

ui-bot: ui-bot: experiment `catalog/presets-toolbar-v1` deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/catalog/compare

Ben (Eng): Edge cases: if pinned version retires we should surface "Pinned version unavailable" with a link to model page. Also, when opening a compare that doesn't include the pinned row, do not auto-select it — show a toast instead.

Carmen (Frontend): Implementation checklist: 1) add presets toolbar (desktop), 2) restyle badges and right-align them, 3) add focus styles `:focus{ outline:3px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.16); }`, 4) ensure badge controls reachable via keyboard and have aria-labels, 5) wire pin API.

Zoe (A11y): I'll run a quick test plan post-deploy (NVDA + VoiceOver). Note: ensure that arrow-key navigation in the presets toolbar announces each preset name.

Ari (Design): Microcopy suggestions: Presets label "Views & presets"; toolbar tooltip "Manage saved views"; pin tooltip "Pin version (keeps this version across sessions)"; toast "Pinned version not included in this compare."

Jo (PM): I'll create the ticket with acceptance criteria: presets toolbar, badge de-emphasis, pin persistence, analytics, accessibility checklist. Target: staging by next Wednesday.

Carmen (Frontend): :+1: Will open PR with screenshots and keyboard walkthrough instructions.

Ari (Design): Thanks team 389. Will upload updated frames and a short prototype in the ticket.
